name: ad-video-tools
description: Rebuild an ad in an existing video's exact layout, with your footage, copy, language and brand. Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux. One git-tracked folder per client: each video's edit and material index are text, the media never is. /init-video scaffolds and verifies; /video-style-clone measures a reference to the pixel, saves it as a reusable template, and builds multilingual cuts, ratio variants and slideshow ads from one params file, in batch, cut to the music's beat, and records where each render went. /video-edit cuts a regular video from a plan or storyboard: it logs every clip and still in a folder, picks the take and in-point per scene, and voices the narration with TTS, times each scene to its line, fills an approved gap with a Gemini-generated still or Veo clip after a price estimate, and renders a 9:16 short with captions, SRT and a QC report. For organic SNS posts, pace: sns snaps cuts to the beat, types or pops captions in, whip-pans, shakes, jump-cuts and speed-ramps, with CC0 sound effects fetched and logged with their source.
